title: Free & Cheap Tokens — MCP Server
description: Run the Free & Cheap Tokens MCP server. Connect any MCP client to the Actor's /mcp endpoint. Tool calls are metered pay-per-event; no monthly fee.

maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Maximum total charge (USD)
maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap on how much this run may charge. Recommended when letting an autonomous agent call the server. Example: 0.10 USD ≈ 20 search calls.

maxItems.title: Maximum number of results per query
maxItems.description: Upper bound for how many promos a single tool call may return.
